mechanism: Topical timolol may have minimal systemic absorption, but fluoxetine can inhibit CYP2D6 which metabolizes timolol, potentially increasing systemic beta-blocker effects if significant absorption occurs.
action: Monitor for signs of bradycardia or hypotension; the interaction risk is minimal with ophthalmic formulation due to low systemic bioavailability, but patient education on proper instillation technique is advised.
